$comment: HZ-383: the contract for a Task's Run plan block — the machine-readable part of the Run plan step's artifact, which HZ-378's Execute reads. Unlike the other *.schema.json files here it pairs with no data file in domain/: it is the contract for an agent's OUTPUT, emitted by the Run plan step and checked by domain/py/run_plan.py (the only binding; there is no JS validator, since only the farm reads the block). Written in the same Draft-07 subset domain/validate.mjs honours. Rules the subset cannot express — every `env` value is a string naming a variable as `$NAME`, never a literal value — are asserted by the binding.
title: Horizon Task run plan

cwd.$comment: The working directory the commands run in, relative to the repository root. Never absolute, never `..` (asserted by the binding, HZ-415); Execute resolves it inside the repo's deploy-target checkout.

commands.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER the commands run in.

env.$comment: Environment variables the commands need, each value a `$NAME` reference — never a literal (asserted by the binding).

runner.$comment: HZ-416: where Execute runs the commands. `container` (the default when absent) is a throwaway rootless Podman container; `host` runs on the host exactly as before HZ-416 and needs an explicit opt-out.

reports.$comment: HZ-434: files the run writes as its own result, shown to Verify & report beside the log. A path is relative to `cwd` or absolute, never with a `..` part (asserted by both bindings). A command's `--report <path>` is found without this list. Execute reads a file only if its realpath is inside the resolved cwd or /tmp.
